name: Nijōin no Sanuki
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 92); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1165.

poems.title: My sleeve is wet with floods of tears
poems.author: Nijōin no Sanuki
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 92
poems.text:
My sleeve is wet with floods of tears
As here I sit and cry;
’Tis wetter than a low-tide rock,
No one, howe’er he try,
Can find a spot that ’s dry!

poems.title: 92. わが袖は 汐干に見えぬ 沖の石の (Waga sode wa shiohi ni mienu oki no ishi no)
poems.author: Nijōin no Sanuki
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
わが袖は 汐干に見えぬ 沖の石の
人こそ知らね 乾く間もなし
